task: photo-editing (flagship 7): noise-aware demosaic for raws with no NoiseProfile
errors: First tool draft seeded noise with Python's per-process hash() (copied from noise_aware_ramp_refit.py); replaced by a SHA-1 seed so reruns reproduce.
bucket step first divided by the scene sigma stored x1000, putting every row in one bucket; caught by comparing with the ad-hoc slice and fixed before writing numbers.
An interim read on the first ~220 rows suggested scales 0.9-1.0 were safe; the full 928 rows reversed that. The write-up uses only the full data.
integrity_issues: The noise/texture buckets were defined after the first, unbucketed held-out reading had been seen; the eval note says so. The scale (0.8) was picked on tune rows only.

doc_friction.issue: Seeds rows with hash((name, ...)), which Python randomizes per process (PYTHONHASHSEED), so its sweeps are not reproducible row for row; the new tools use a SHA-1 seed.

The synthetic-noise harness's 4x4-binned references carry fine texture as loud as SNR 30-60 noise (median sigma 3.3e-3 at 18% grey); the earlier notes do not say so, and it bounds what any SNR 60 / 200 row can show about noise models.
A hook blocks 'sleep N; cmd' as a wait; the guidance to use run_in_background or an until-loop is in the hook message only, not in cloud-session.md's 'Long commands'.

deviations.why: The flagship default asks for a working slice landed; the measurement showed the frame-read model is unsafe as the automatic fallback, so it shipped opt-in behind --noise-from-frame instead of replacing the fallback.
deviations.did: Opt-in flag, default unchanged, with the negative result written up.
deviations.result: Users with high-ISO raws get the blend; nobody's default output changes.

goal: Deepen flagship 7 (photo-editing): make the noise-aware demosaic usable on raws read directly.
notes: Venture suite: run_venture_tests.py photo-editing ok, 1280 tests, 9 skipped (95 s). ruff check clean. Sweep: 464 rows per layout, 46 files, about 20 min on four processes. Real-file smoke run: X-E1 RAF and A500 ARW develop with --noise-from-frame (24 s / 12.8 s vs 6.5 s / 2.4 s directional). Local mypy could not run (numpy 2.5 stubs need Python 3.12 syntax vs the config's target); CI runs it.
